ai.title: AI assist
ai.subtitle: When a line reads like a sentence instead of the shorthand, CoreTrack can offer what it thinks you meant. You confirm it — nothing is ever filed for you.
ai.previewNote: Beta. It gets things wrong, and saying so is one tap. That is what makes the next version better.
ai.keysHint: Press Tab to add them to your line. Enter still saves exactly what is in the box, and Esc hides this.
ai.announce: Suggestion: {summary}. Press Tab to add it to your line.
ai.reportedToast: Ignored. Thanks for the correction — it won't offer that again.
ai.toggleHint: Applies to your account, on every device you sign in on.
ai.prefsUnread: Your setting could not be read, so nothing is being sent. Capture works exactly as it did before.
ai.sentBody: Only what is listed here, only when a line does not already make sense on its own, and only while the switch above is on.
ai.sentLine: The line you typed, once you stop typing.
ai.sentNames: The names of this workspace's tracks and members — read on the server, from your own workspace — so a suggestion can point at real ones.
ai.sentToday: Today's date, so “next Friday” means the right Friday.
ai.notSentHistory: No entries, no history, no files.
ai.notSentUpdates: No updates, no comments, no meeting notes.
ai.keyNote: The key is held on the server as a secret. It is never in the app and never in your browser.
ai.neverFiles: A suggestion only ever adds words to the box. Nothing is saved until you press Enter, and your own words are never rewritten.
ai.usageHint: Counted per person, and it starts again at midnight.
ai.errNetwork: Couldn't reach the suggestion service. Capture is unaffected.
ai.errTooLong: That line is too long to send. Meeting Mode is the place for pasted notes.
ai.errBusy: Too many suggestions at once. Try again in a moment.
ai.errLimit: Today's suggestion limit has been reached. It starts again at midnight.
ai.errUnconfigured: AI assist is not set up on the server yet.
ai.errUpstream: The suggestion service didn't answer. Capture is unaffected.
ai.errRefused: The assistant declined to answer that line. Nothing was saved or sent anywhere else.
ai.errPrefsMissing: This switch has nowhere to be saved yet, so it lasts for this session only. Suggestions are on.
